# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1508
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1508
- **Title**: fix(network): web WebSockets now authenticate via ?token= — messages send from fa1.dev/app
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/network-web-ws-token` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +84
- **Deletions**: -6
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T18:38:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T20:05:28Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Sending channel messages from the web build (fa1.dev/app) silently did nothing while macOS worked.

## Root cause
The browser WebSocket API cannot set headers, so `PlatformWsConnector` (web conditional) connected to `wss://network.fa1.dev/ws` **unauthenticated** — the server 401'd (its auth contract requires the session token). Desktop uses `IOWebSocketChannel` with an `Authorization` header, which is why only web was broken.

## Fix
fa_network deployed `?token=` support on `/ws` (header stays priority). `PlatformWsConnector` now lifts `Authorization: Bearer <t>` into the URI query via a pure, unit-tested `liftBearerIntoQuery` helper. Stale "not in the contract yet" doc comment updated.

## Tests
- New `ws_connector_web_test.dart`: 6 cases (bare URI, query preservation, stale-token replace, no-header, non-bearer, empty bearer) — all green.
- `dart analyze` clean; pre-commit golden gate passed.

## Verified backend-side (not this diff)
CORS preflight → 204 with ACAO; bad `?token=` → 401 (auth contract intact); REST `POST /api/networks` → 401 `auth token required` as expected.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1508
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1508
- **Title**: fix(network): web WebSockets now authenticate via ?token= — messages send from fa1.dev/app
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/network-web-ws-token` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +84
- **Deletions**: -6
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T18:38:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T20:05:28Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Sending channel messages from the web build (fa1.dev/app) silently did nothing while macOS worked.

## Root cause
The browser WebSocket API cannot set headers, so `PlatformWsConnector` (web conditional) connected to `wss://network.fa1.dev/ws` **unauthenticated** — the server 401'd (its auth contract requires the session token). Desktop uses `IOWebSocketChannel` with an `Authorization` header, which is why only web was broken.

## Fix
fa_network deployed `?token=` support on `/ws` (header stays priority). `PlatformWsConnector` now lifts `Authorization: Bearer <t>` into the URI query via a pure, unit-tested `liftBearerIntoQuery` helper. Stale "not in the contract yet" doc comment updated.

## Tests
- New `ws_connector_web_test.dart`: 6 cases (bare URI, query preservation, stale-token replace, no-header, non-bearer, empty bearer) — all green.
- `dart analyze` clean; pre-commit golden gate passed.

## Verified backend-side (not this diff)
CORS preflight → 204 with ACAO; bad `?token=` → 401 (auth contract intact); REST `POST /api/networks` → 401 `auth token required` as expected.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
💡 **SUGGESTION: Bearer scheme check is case-sensitive**

```dart
const prefix = 'Bearer ';
if (!auth.startsWith(prefix)) return wsUri;
```

Per RFC 6750 the auth-scheme is case-insensitive, so `Authorization: bearer <t>` is legal — but this check rejects it and silently falls through to an unauthenticated connect (the server then 401s, same failure mode this PR fixes). Cheap hardening:

```dart
if (!auth.toLowerCase().startsWith('bearer ')) return wsUri;
final token = [REDACTED:Sensitive Value]'bearer '.length).trim();
```

Same consideration applies to the exact `headers['Authorization']` key — fine today since `FaNetworkWs._open` builds that exact casing, but worth a comment if you keep the exact match.

Lifting the session token into `?token=` means every fa_network access log line (and any intermediate proxy/CDN log) for `/ws` will contain a live session token. # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1508
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1508
- **Title**: fix(network): web WebSockets now authenticate via ?token= — messages send from fa1.dev/app
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/network-web-ws-token` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +84
- **Deletions**: -6
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T18:38:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T20:05:28Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Sending channel messages from the web build (fa1.dev/app) silently did nothing while macOS worked.

## Root cause
The browser WebSocket API cannot set headers, so `PlatformWsConnector` (web conditional) connected to `wss://network.fa1.dev/ws` **unauthenticated** — the server 401'd (its auth contract requires the session token). Desktop uses `IOWebSocketChannel` with an `Authorization` header, which is why only web was broken.

## Fix
fa_network deployed `?token=` support on `/ws` (header stays priority). `PlatformWsConnector` now lifts `Authorization: Bearer <t>` into the URI query via a pure, unit-tested `liftBearerIntoQuery` helper. Stale "not in the contract yet" doc comment updated.

## Tests
- New `ws_connector_web_test.dart`: 6 cases (bare URI, query preservation, stale-token replace, no-header, non-bearer, empty bearer) — all green.
- `dart analyze` clean; pre-commit golden gate passed.

## Verified backend-side (not this diff)
CORS preflight → 204 with ACAO; bad `?token=` → 401 (auth contract intact); REST `POST /api/networks` → 401 `auth token required` as expected.

### Thread 1 — `flutter_app/lib/network/ws_connector_web.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
💡 **SUGGESTION: Bearer scheme check is case-sensitive**

```dart
const prefix = 'Bearer ';
if (!auth.startsWith(prefix)) return wsUri;
```

Per RFC 6750 the auth-scheme is case-insensitive, so `Authorization: bearer <t>` is legal — but this check rejects it and silently falls through to an unauthenticated connect (the server then 401s, same failure mode this PR fixes). Cheap hardening:

```dart
if (!auth.toLowerCase().startsWith('bearer ')) return wsUri;
final token = [REDACTED:Sensitive Value]'bearer '.length).trim();
```

Same consideration applies to the exact `headers['Authorization']` key — fine today since `FaNetworkWs._open` builds that exact casing, but worth a comment if you keep the exact match.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
💡 **SUGGESTION: token now lands in URI — ensure server-side log redaction**

Lifting the session token into `?token=` means every fa_network access log line (and any intermediate proxy/CDN log) for `/ws` will contain a live session token. That is inherent to the deployed `?token=` contract, so nothing to change in this diff — but please confirm (backend-side) that the token query param is redacted/masked in access logs, and that log retention for those lines is bounded. # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1508
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1508
- **Title**: fix(network): web WebSockets now authenticate via ?token= — messages send from fa1.dev/app
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/network-web-ws-token` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +84
- **Deletions**: -6
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T18:38:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T20:05:28Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Sending channel messages from the web build (fa1.dev/app) silently did nothing while macOS worked.

## Root cause
The browser WebSocket API cannot set headers, so `PlatformWsConnector` (web conditional) connected to `wss://network.fa1.dev/ws` **unauthenticated** — the server 401'd (its auth contract requires the session token). Desktop uses `IOWebSocketChannel` with an `Authorization` header, which is why only web was broken.

## Fix
fa_network deployed `?token=` support on `/ws` (header stays priority). `PlatformWsConnector` now lifts `Authorization: Bearer <t>` into the URI query via a pure, unit-tested `liftBearerIntoQuery` helper. Stale "not in the contract yet" doc comment updated.

## Tests
- New `ws_connector_web_test.dart`: 6 cases (bare URI, query preservation, stale-token replace, no-header, non-bearer, empty bearer) — all green.
- `dart analyze` clean; pre-commit golden gate passed.

## Verified backend-side (not this diff)
CORS preflight → 204 with ACAO; bad `?token=` → 401 (auth contract intact); REST `POST /api/networks` → 401 `auth token required` as expected.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
💡 **SUGGESTION: Bearer scheme check is case-sensitive**

```dart
const prefix = 'Bearer ';
if (!auth.startsWith(prefix)) return wsUri;
```

Per RFC 6750 the auth-scheme is case-insensitive, so `Authorization: bearer <t>` is legal — but this check rejects it and silently falls through to an unauthenticated connect (the server then 401s, same failure mode this PR fixes). Cheap hardening:

```dart
if (!auth.toLowerCase().startsWith('bearer ')) return wsUri;
final token = [REDACTED:Sensitive Value]'bearer '.length).trim();
```

Same consideration applies to the exact `headers['Authorization']` key — fine today since `FaNetworkWs._open` builds that exact casing, but worth a comment if you keep the exact match.

Lifting the session token into `?token=` means every fa_network access log line (and any intermediate proxy/CDN log) for `/ws` will contain a live session token. # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1508

- **Title**: fix(network): web WebSockets now authenticate via ?token= — messages send from fa1.dev/app
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/network-web-ws-token` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +84
- **Deletions**: -6
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T18:38:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T20:05:28Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Sending channel messages from the web build (fa1.dev/app) silently did nothing while macOS worked.

## Root cause
The browser WebSocket API cannot set headers, so `PlatformWsConnector` (web conditional) connected to `wss://network.fa1.dev/ws` **unauthenticated** — the server 401'd (its auth contract requires the session token). Desktop uses `IOWebSocketChannel` with an `Authorization` header, which is why only web was broken.

## Fix
fa_network deployed `?token=` support on `/ws` (header stays priority). `PlatformWsConnector` now lifts `Authorization: Bearer <t>` into the URI query via a pure, unit-tested `liftBearerIntoQuery` helper. Stale "not in the contract yet" doc comment updated.

## Tests
- New `ws_connector_web_test.dart`: 6 cases (bare URI, query preservation, stale-token replace, no-header, non-bearer, empty bearer) — all green.
- `dart analyze` clean; pre-commit golden gate passed.

## Verified backend-side (not this diff)
CORS preflight → 204 with ACAO; bad `?token=` → 401 (auth contract intact); REST `POST /api/networks` → 401 `auth token required` as expected.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1508
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1508
- **Title**: fix(network): web WebSockets now authenticate via ?token= — messages send from fa1.dev/app
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/network-web-ws-token` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +84
- **Deletions**: -6
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T18:38:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T20:05:28Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Sending channel messages from the web build (fa1.dev/app) silently did nothing while macOS worked.

## Root cause
The browser WebSocket API cannot set headers, so `PlatformWsConnector` (web conditional) connected to `wss://network.fa1.dev/ws` **unauthenticated** — the server 401'd (its auth contract requires the session token). Desktop uses `IOWebSocketChannel` with an `Authorization` header, which is why only web was broken.

## Fix
fa_network deployed `?token=` support on `/ws` (header stays priority). `PlatformWsConnector` now lifts `Authorization: Bearer <t>` into the URI query via a pure, unit-tested `liftBearerIntoQuery` helper. Stale "not in the contract yet" doc comment updated.

## Tests
- New `ws_connector_web_test.dart`: 6 cases (bare URI, query preservation, stale-token replace, no-header, non-bearer, empty bearer) — all green.
- `dart analyze` clean; pre-commit golden gate passed.

## Verified backend-side (not this diff)
CORS preflight → 204 with ACAO; bad `?token=` → 401 (auth contract intact); REST `POST /api/networks` → 401 `auth token required` as expected.

💡 **SUGGESTION: Bearer scheme check is case-sensitive**

```dart
const prefix = 'Bearer ';
```

Per RFC 6750 the auth-scheme is case-insensitive, so `Authorization: bearer <t>` is legal — but this check rejects it and silently falls through to an unauthenticated connect (the server then 401s, same failure mode this PR fixes). Cheap hardening:

```dart
if (!auth.toLowerCase().startsWith('bearer ')) return wsUri;
final token = [REDACTED:Sensitive Value]'bearer '.length).trim();
```

- **Title**: fix(network): web WebSockets now authenticate via ?token= — messages send from fa1.dev/app
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/network-web-ws-token` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +84
- **Deletions**: -6
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T18:38:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T20:05:28Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Sending channel messages from the web build (fa1.dev/app) silently did nothing while macOS worked.

## Root cause
The browser WebSocket API cannot set headers, so `PlatformWsConnector` (web conditional) connected to `wss://network.fa1.dev/ws` **unauthenticated** — the server 401'd (its auth contract requires the session token). Desktop uses `IOWebSocketChannel` with an `Authorization` header, which is why only web was broken.

## Fix
fa_network deployed `?token=` support on `/ws` (header stays priority). `PlatformWsConnector` now lifts `Authorization: Bearer <t>` into the URI query via a pure, unit-tested `liftBearerIntoQuery` helper. Stale "not in the contract yet" doc comment updated.

## Tests
- New `ws_connector_web_test.dart`: 6 cases (bare URI, query preservation, stale-token replace, no-header, non-bearer, empty bearer) — all green.
- `dart analyze` clean; pre-commit golden gate passed.

## Verified backend-side (not this diff)
CORS preflight → 204 with ACAO; bad `?token=` → 401 (auth contract intact); REST `POST /api/networks` → 401 `auth token required` as expected.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
💡 **SUGGESTION: Bearer scheme check is case-sensitive**

```dart
const prefix = 'Bearer ';
if (!auth.startsWith(prefix)) return wsUri;
```

Per RFC 6750 the auth-scheme is case-insensitive, so `Authorization: bearer <t>` is legal — but this check rejects it and silently falls through to an unauthenticated connect (the server then 401s, same failure mode this PR fixes). Cheap hardening:

```dart
if (!auth.toLowerCase().startsWith('bearer ')) return wsUri;
final token = [REDACTED:Sensitive Value]'bearer '.length).trim();
```

Same consideration applies to the exact `headers['Authorization']` key — fine today since `FaNetworkWs._open` builds that exact casing, but worth a comment if you keep the exact match.

### Thread 2 — `flutter_app/lib/network/ws_connector_web.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
💡 **SUGGESTION: token now lands in URI — ensure server-side log redaction**

Lifting the session token into `?token=` means every fa_network access log line (and any intermediate proxy/CDN log) for `/ws` will contain a live session token. That is inherent to the deployed `?token=` contract, so nothing to change in this diff — but please confirm (backend-side) that the token query param is redacted/masked in access logs, and that log retention for those lines is bounded. A token in long-retained logs is a credential-leak hazard if the logs are ever shared or breached.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1508
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1508
- **Title**: fix(network): web WebSockets now authenticate via ?token= — messages send from fa1.dev/app
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/network-web-ws-token` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +84
- **Deletions**: -6
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T18:38:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T20:05:28Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Sending channel messages from the web build (fa1.dev/app) silently did nothing while macOS worked.

## Root cause
The browser WebSocket API cannot set headers, so `PlatformWsConnector` (web conditional) connected to `wss://network.fa1.dev/ws` **unauthenticated** — the server 401'd (its auth contract requires the session token). Desktop uses `IOWebSocketChannel` with an `Authorization` header, which is why only web was broken.

## Fix
fa_network deployed `?token=` support on `/ws` (header stays priority). `PlatformWsConnector` now lifts `Authorization: Bearer <t>` into the URI query via a pure, unit-tested `liftBearerIntoQuery` helper. Stale "not in the contract yet" doc comment updated.

## Tests
- New `ws_connector_web_test.dart`: 6 cases (bare URI, query preservation, stale-token replace, no-header, non-bearer, empty bearer) — all green.
- `dart analyze` clean; pre-commit golden gate passed.

## Verified backend-side (not this diff)
CORS preflight → 204 with ACAO; bad `?token=` → 401 (auth contract intact); REST `POST /api/networks` → 401 `auth token required` as expected.

💡 **SUGGESTION: Bearer scheme check is case-sensitive**

```dart
const prefix = 'Bearer ';
```

Per RFC 6750 the auth-scheme is case-insensitive, so `Authorization: bearer <t>` is legal — but this check rejects it and silently falls through to an unauthenticated connect (the server then 401s, same failure mode this PR fixes). Cheap hardening:

```dart
if (!auth.toLowerCase().startsWith('bearer ')) return wsUri;
```

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +84
- **Deletions**: -6
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T18:38:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T20:05:28Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Sending channel messages from the web build (fa1.dev/app) silently did nothing while macOS worked.

## Root cause
The browser WebSocket API cannot set headers, so `PlatformWsConnector` (web conditional) connected to `wss://network.fa1.dev/ws` **unauthenticated** — the server 401'd (its auth contract requires the session token). Desktop uses `IOWebSocketChannel` with an `Authorization` header, which is why only web was broken.

## Fix
fa_network deployed `?token=` support on `/ws` (header stays priority). `PlatformWsConnector` now lifts `Authorization: Bearer <t>` into the URI query via a pure, unit-tested `liftBearerIntoQuery` helper. Stale "not in the contract yet" doc comment updated.

## Tests
- New `ws_connector_web_test.dart`: 6 cases (bare URI, query preservation, stale-token replace, no-header, non-bearer, empty bearer) — all green.
- `dart analyze` clean; pre-commit golden gate passed.

## Verified backend-side (not this diff)
CORS preflight → 204 with ACAO; bad `?token=` → 401 (auth contract intact); REST `POST /api/networks` → 401 `auth token required` as expected.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1508
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1508
- **Title**: fix(network): web WebSockets now authenticate via ?token= — messages send from fa1.dev/app
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/network-web-ws-token` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +84
- **Deletions**: -6
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T18:38:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T20:05:28Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Sending channel messages from the web build (fa1.dev/app) silently did nothing while macOS worked.

## Root cause
The browser WebSocket API cannot set headers, so `PlatformWsConnector` (web conditional) connected to `wss://network.fa1.dev/ws` **unauthenticated** — the server 401'd (its auth contract requires the session token). Desktop uses `IOWebSocketChannel` with an `Authorization` header, which is why only web was broken.

## Fix
fa_network deployed `?token=` support on `/ws` (header stays priority). `PlatformWsConnector` now lifts `Authorization: Bearer <t>` into the URI query via a pure, unit-tested `liftBearerIntoQuery` helper. Stale "not in the contract yet" doc comment updated.

## Tests
- New `ws_connector_web_test.dart`: 6 cases (bare URI, query preservation, stale-token replace, no-header, non-bearer, empty bearer) — all green.
- `dart analyze` clean; pre-commit golden gate passed.

## Verified backend-side (not this diff)
CORS preflight → 204 with ACAO; bad `?token=` → 401 (auth contract intact); REST `POST /api/networks` → 401 `auth token required` as expected.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1508
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1508
- **Title**: fix(network): web WebSockets now authenticate via ?token= — messages send from fa1.dev/app
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/network-web-ws-token` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +84
- **Deletions**: -6
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T18:38:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T20:05:28Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Sending channel messages from the web build (fa1.dev/app) silently did nothing while macOS worked.

## Root cause
The browser WebSocket API cannot set headers, so `PlatformWsConnector` (web conditional) connected to `wss://network.fa1.dev/ws` **unauthenticated** — the server 401'd (its auth contract requires the session token). Desktop uses `IOWebSocketChannel` with an `Authorization` header, which is why only web was broken.

## Fix
fa_network deployed `?token=` support on `/ws` (header stays priority). `PlatformWsConnector` now lifts `Authorization: Bearer <t>` into the URI query via a pure, unit-tested `liftBearerIntoQuery` helper. Stale "not in the contract yet" doc comment updated.

## Tests
- New `ws_connector_web_test.dart`: 6 cases (bare URI, query preservation, stale-token replace, no-header, non-bearer, empty bearer) — all green.
- `dart analyze` clean; pre-commit golden gate passed.

## Verified backend-side (not this diff)
CORS preflight → 204 with ACAO; bad `?token=` → 401 (auth contract intact); REST `POST /api/networks` → 401 `auth token required` as expected.

  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm

    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate

- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T20:05:28Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Sending channel messages from the web build (fa1.dev/app) silently did nothing while macOS worked.

## Root cause
The browser WebSocket API cannot set headers, so `PlatformWsConnector` (web conditional) connected to `wss://network.fa1.dev/ws` **unauthenticated** — the server 401'd (its auth contract requires the session token). Desktop uses `IOWebSocketChannel` with an `Authorization` header, which is why only web was broken.

## Fix
fa_network deployed `?token=` support on `/ws` (header stays priority). `PlatformWsConnector` now lifts `Authorization: Bearer <t>` into the URI query via a pure, unit-tested `liftBearerIntoQuery` helper. Stale "not in the contract yet" doc comment updated.

## Tests
- New `ws_connector_web_test.dart`: 6 cases (bare URI, query preservation, stale-token replace, no-header, non-bearer, empty bearer) — all green.
- `dart analyze` clean; pre-commit golden gate passed.

## Verified backend-side (not this diff)
CORS preflight → 204 with ACAO; bad `?token=` → 401 (auth contract intact); REST `POST /api/networks` → 401 `auth token required` as expected.

- **PR #**: 1508

- **Title**: fix(network): web WebSockets now authenticate via ?token= — messages send from fa1.dev/app
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/network-web-ws-token` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +84
- **Deletions**: -6
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T18:38:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T20:05:28Z

## PR Description

## Problem
Sending channel messages from the web build (fa1.dev/app) silently did nothing while macOS worked.

## Root cause
The browser WebSocket API cannot set headers, so `PlatformWsConnector` (web conditional) connected to `wss://network.fa1.dev/ws` **unauthenticated** — the server 401'd (its auth contract requires the session token). Desktop uses `IOWebSocketChannel` with an `Authorization` header, which is why only web was broken.

## Fix
fa_network deployed `?token=` support on `/ws` (header stays priority). `PlatformWsConnector` now lifts `Authorization: Bearer <t>` into the URI query via a pure, unit-tested `liftBearerIntoQuery` helper. Stale "not in the contract yet" doc comment updated.

## Tests
- New `ws_connector_web_test.dart`: 6 cases (bare URI, query preservation, stale-token replace, no-header, non-bearer, empty bearer) — all green.
- `dart analyze` clean; pre-commit golden gate passed.

## Verified backend-side (not this diff)
CORS preflight → 204 with ACAO; bad `?token=` → 401 (auth contract intact); REST `POST /api/networks` → 401 `auth token required` as expected.

### Thread 1 — `flutter_app/lib/network/ws_connector_web.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
💡 **SUGGESTION: Bearer scheme check is case-sensitive**

```dart
const prefix = 'Bearer ';
if (!auth.startsWith(prefix)) return wsUri;
```

Per RFC 6750 the auth-scheme is case-insensitive, so `Authorization: bearer <t>` is legal — but this check rejects it and silently falls through to an unauthenticated connect (the server then 401s, same failure mode this PR fixes). Cheap hardening:

```dart
if (!auth.toLowerCase().startsWith('bearer ')) return wsUri;
final token = [REDACTED:Sensitive Value]'bearer '.length).trim();
```

Same consideration applies to the exact `headers['Authorization']` key — fine today since `FaNetworkWs._open` builds that exact casing, but worth a comment if you keep the exact match.

---

### Thread 2 — `flutter_app/lib/network/ws_connector_web.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
💡 **SUGGESTION: token now lands in URI — ensure server-side log redaction**

Lifting the session token into `?token=` means every fa_network access log line (and any intermediate proxy/CDN log) for `/ws` will contain a live session token. That is inherent to the deployed `?token=` contract, so nothing to change in this diff — but please confirm (backend-side) that the token query param is redacted/masked in access logs, and that log retention for those lines is bounded. A token in long-retained logs is a credential-leak hazard if the logs are ever shared or breached.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)

arguments.content:
# Rework — PR #1508: web WebSocket `?token=` auth

## Issues/Notes

- **No CI failures** on the rework head; review decision `NONE`, verdict leg was APPROVE with 2 suggestion-level threads open.
- Open actionable threads were the two inline suggestions on `flutter_app/lib/network/ws_connector_web.dart`. The remaining "threads" in `pr_discussions_raw.json` are top-level machine records (review-verdict, rework-consume) with no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` and explicit "do not reply" markers — no replies generated for them.
- First run of `flutter test test/network/` showed a single load-level failure (0 passed / 1 failed); a deliberate re-run of the same frozen tree passed **328/328** — treated as a flake, no code change between runs.

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN) for the case-sensitivity finding, then docs for the rest:

1. **RED** — added 3 tests to `flutter_app/test/network/ws_connector_web_test.dart`: `bearer` (lowercase), `BEARER` (uppercase), `BeArEr` (mixed) schemes must lift the token into `?token=`. All 3 failed against the old `startsWith('Bearer ')` check.
2. **GREEN** — `liftBearerIntoQuery` now matches the auth-scheme case-insensitively per RFC 6750 (`auth.toLowerCase().startsWith('bearer ')`, token sliced after `'bearer '.length`). Kept the exact `headers['Authorization']` key match, with an inline comment noting `FaNetworkWs._open` builds that exact casing today. All 9 file tests pass.
3. **Log-redaction thread** — reviewer confirmed nothing to change in this diff (server-side concern). Documented the obligation at the source: `liftBearerIntoQuery` doc now carries a SECURITY note that the token lands in the URI query and the deployed fa_network contract requires `token` redaction/masking in access logs with bounded retention (server-side, not enforceable from the browser).
4. **Stale-doc next step from the APPROVE summary** — `fa_network_ws.dart` `WebSocketChannelConnector` typedef doc still claimed web is "headerless (server 401s) … until the contract grows a browser-compatible auth path"; updated to describe the `?token=` lift that this PR ships.

## Files Modified

- `flutter_app/lib/network/ws_connector_web.dart` — case-insensitive bearer scheme match + doc updates (RFC 6750 note, SECURITY log-redaction note).
- `flutter_app/lib/network/fa_network_ws.dart` — stale `WebSocketChannelConnector` typedef doc corrected.
- `flutter_app/test/network/ws_connector_web_test.dart` — 3 new case-insensitive scheme regression tests.

## Test Coverage

- `flutter test test/network/ws_connector_web_test.dart` — **9/9 pass** (6 pre-existing + 3 new; new ones verified RED before the fix).
- `flutter test test/network/` — **328/328 pass** (full network suite, no regressions; re-run after a flake-level first attempt).
- `flutter analyze` on the 3 changed files — no issues.
- `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` on the 3 changed files — clean.

## Review Replies

- `outputs/review_replies/thread_1.md` → thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6rHS6C` (case-sensitive Bearer check) — fixed in code.
- `outputs/review_replies/thread_2.md` → thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6rHS7P` (token in URI / log redaction) — confirmed server-side, SECURITY note added at the lift site.
